mentions.name: NavigateAnyMap
mentions.description: Android app that lets users navigate using a photo of any physical map. It georeferences ('fixes') the photo onto an OpenStreetMap.org background using Exif information, so the fixed photo is mapped to GPS coordinates and can be shared.
mentions.audience: Hikers and outdoor enthusiasts who use physical paper maps; the author has reached out to local hiking clubs and reports around 100 users worldwide.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on my Android app (navigateanymap.eu) that enables you to navigate using any (photo of) any physical map.

Have tried contacting local hiking clubs to use my app (the app 'fixes' a photo to an OpenStreetMap.org background with the use of Exif information, so that a fixed photo can be shared which is already mapped to GPS coordinates) but no luck so far.
